```{python}
#| output: asis
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
from _helpers import load, render_paper

p = load("profile")
edu = load("education")
emp = load("employment")
pubs = load("publications")
v = load("visits")
g = load("grants")
s = load("service")
st = load("students")
t = load("teaching")

# Header
c = p["contact"]
print(f"## {p['name']['full']}\n")
print(f"{p['title']}, {p['affiliation']['long']}  \n")
print(f"{c['address'].strip().replace(chr(10), '  ' + chr(10))}  \n")
print(f"📧 [{c['email']}](mailto:{c['email']}) · ☎ {c['phone']}\n")
```

## Education

```{python}
#| output: asis
from _helpers import load
edu = load("education")
for e in edu:
    line = f"**{e['years']}** — {e['degree']}"
    if e.get("field"):
        line += f", {e['field']}"
    line += f", {e['institution']}, {e.get('location','')}"
    if e.get("thesis"):
        th = e["thesis"]
        line += f". Thesis: *{th['title']}*. Committee: " + ", ".join(th.get("committee", []))
    print(f"- {line}")
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
# "Under Review" is printed from here rather than as a markdown heading so the
# heading disappears when nothing is under review (currently the case).
from _helpers import load, render_paper
pubs = load("publications")
under_review = [p for p in pubs.get("under_review", []) if not p.get("skip_website")]
if under_review:
    print("### Under Review\n")
    for p in under_review:
        print(render_paper(p))
```

## Service

```{python}
#| output: asis
from _helpers import load
s = load("service")

if s.get("editorial"):
    print("\n### Editorial Work\n")
    for e in s["editorial"]:
        print(f"- {e['role']} for *{e['journal']}*, {e['start']}–{e['end']}")

if s.get("program_committees"):
    print("\n### Program Committees & Reviewing\n")
    for c in s["program_committees"]:
        bits = [c["committee"], c.get("role", "")]
        if c.get("note"):
            bits.append(c["note"])
        print("- " + " — ".join(b for b in bits if b))

if s.get("peer_review"):
    print("\n### Peer Review Panels\n")
    for r in s["peer_review"]:
        if r.get("year"):
            yrs = str(r["year"])
        else:
            yrs = f"{r['start']}–{r.get('end') or 'present'}"
        print(f"- {r['name']}, {yrs}")

# NOTE: external_reviews (tenure & promotion cases) are PRIVATE per user direction —
# kept in data/service.yml for the printable LaTeX CV only, not rendered on the public web CV.

if s.get("keynotes"):
    print("\n### Keynote Speeches\n")
    for k in s["keynotes"]:
        print(f"- *{k['title']}* — {k['venue']}, {k['date']}")

if s.get("referee_for"):
    print("\n### Refereeing\n")
    print("Referee for: " + ", ".join(s["referee_for"]) + ".\n")
```

## Teaching Experience

```{python}

from _helpers import load

        print(line)
```

## PhD Students

```{python}
#| output: asis
from _helpers import load
st = load("students")

print("\n### Main Advisor — Current\n")
for s in st["current_advisees"]:
    print(f"- **{s['start']}–** — {s['name']}, {s['institution']} ({s['field']})")

print("\n### Main Advisor — Past\n")
for s in st["past_advisees"]:
    when = s.get("graduated") or s.get("years")
    line = f"- **{when}** — {s['name']}, {s['institution']} ({s['field']})"
    if s.get("placement"):
        line += f". {s['placement']}"
    print(line)

if st.get("notable_committee_roles"):
    print("\n### Committee Roles\n")
    for s in st["notable_committee_roles"]:
        line = f"- **{s.get('graduated','')}** — {s['name']}, {s['institution']} ({s['field']}) — {s.get('role','')}"
        if s.get("placement"):
            line += f". {s['placement']}"
        print(line)

if st.get("cv_only_examiner_roles"):
    print("\n### External Examiner / Reviewer\n")
    for r in st["cv_only_examiner_roles"]:
        print(f"- **{r['year']}** — {r['role']}, {r['candidate']}, {r['institution']}")
```

## Awards, Grants, and Fellowships

```{python}
#| output: asis
from _helpers import load
g = load("grants")
for sec_name, sec_key in [("Fellowships and Grants (Current)", "shown_on_website"),
                          ("Other Awards, Grants, Scholarships", "cv_only")]:
    items = g.get(sec_key, []) or []
    if not items:
        continue
    print(f"\n### {sec_name}\n")
    for item in items:
        yrs = ""
        if item.get("start"):
            yrs = f"{item['start']}–{item.get('end') or 'present'}"
        elif item.get("year"):
            yrs = str(item["year"])
        elif item.get("years"):
            yrs = item["years"]
        extra = ""
        if item.get("amount_gbp"):
            extra = f" · £{item['amount_gbp']:,}"
        elif item.get("amount_cad"):
            extra = f" · CAD {item['amount_cad']:,}"
        print(f"- **{yrs}** — {item['name']}{extra}")
```
